normalized.result: Yes, this is exactly the protection I meant by "nothing gets lost." The card clearly explains the original page is unavailable but a saved copy is ready, and clicking "Open saved copy" gave me the full readable article — title, description, and the whole body text — captured back when I saved it, opening in a new tab while my library stayed put. So even when a page disappears from the web, I still have what I saved. This works well for me.
